disorder-name.detail: Parkinson's disease; clinical cohort. Diagnosed per UKPDSBB and/or MDS criteria. Data aggregated from 5 sites: Dataset 3 (BASEL, n=68), Dataset 4 (UNMPD, n=25), Dataset 5 (CREAPARK, n=24), Dataset 7 (turkeyPDAD, n=100), Dataset 11 (UHTPD, n=20).
